recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If maintainers want to remove or update the unreferenced stale XML copy in source/medicationadministration, handle that separately as repository cleanup rather than as normative FHIR-5519 reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-5519 is a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core change request asking to implement changes required to align the Immunization and MedicationAdministration resources; its resolution says the work was done in the September 2014 and January 2015 WGMs.
initial_application: No historical commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-5519 was found. The strongest implementation trail is 5350fdb47507aa316ec0da7985d650a4889455f6, a 2015-01-20 commit titled "Harmonize Immunization and MedicationAdministration" that changed the old MedicationAdministration spreadsheet source by making practitioner and prescription optional and adding reasonGiven support.
additional_context: Both resources are active in source/fhir.ini. Later published harmonization work, especially FHIR-11091, has already been audited on the combined branch. Current StructureDefinition source maps both resources to the workflow Event pattern and uses current statusReason, reason, occurrence[x], performer, and migration aliases rather than reopening old DSTU1/DSTU2 names. A stale Immunization example copy under source/medicationadministration contains old element names, but no build-scope reference to that file was found; the active Immunization example list points to the corrected source/immunization example.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The seed issue's requested historical alignment is already represented in current build-scoped source, and editing the unreferenced stale copy would not be a current-spec fix.
